title: FAPI Security Header & Compliance Validator
description: Validates HTTP security headers against FAPI 1.0 Advanced and FAPI 2.0 Message Signing standards. Checks for PKCE, DPoP, PAR, mTLS, and required header values. Produces a security compliance report with gap remediation guidance.

headers.description: HTTP header key-value pairs to validate

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_fapi_security_headers
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validate HTTP security headers against FAPI 1.0 Advanced or FAPI 2.0 standards. Returns pass/warn/fail counts, a compliance score, and specific remediation steps for each failing header. Use when an agent needs to assess the security posture of an open banking API endpoint.
